beats.text:
The door opens before you knock.

She has been standing on the other side of it for a while.

text.Guns: She was already at the door. She needed you to be someone.
text.Bible: Waiting like that isn't patience. That's a vigil.
text.Crystals: She's been standing there so long her feet must ache. Nobody stands like that for nothing.

options.label: Say nothing. Let her fill it.
